predecessors.note: M7 reuses M4 natal-feature types and does not mutate the M4 Pattern response. AI-cohort GET /v1/pattern is an M7 successor document.

M7 copies M5 frozen-command, encrypted-outbox, and strict-provider posture. It does not widen ai_synthesis or the daily-reading command. RE-PINNED 2026-08-27: contracts/m5 gained the amendment recorded in its own SCHEMA_MANIFEST.json amendments array, widening publisherProvider from const "openai" to the exact enum ["openai", "codex"] so Codex-generated daily readings can be described truthfully while historical OpenAI evidence stays readable. The digest above is the post-amendment value; every instance that validated under the const still validates, and no $id, required field, or schema_version moved.
M6 account-export remains frozen. M7 ships a successor export document with an explicit patterns section.

supersedes.note: Supersession applies only to accounts that have entered the AI Pattern path. Editorial-cohort GET /v1/pattern remains the frozen M4 document.
Forward-only successor. Stored M6 export artifacts remain valid under their own frozen document.

openapi.describes: Consumer Pattern generation, Pattern consent, AI-cohort Pattern document, internal ontology ingest/recall/reconcile, and administrative metadata, inventory, decrypt, and ontology-release inspection.

amendments.change: Added patternConsentRevocation to pattern-consent.schema.json and pointed DELETE /v1/consents/pattern-generation at it.
amendments.reason: Design spec 19.3 documents the revoke response as a {schema_version, consent, existing_pattern_retained} envelope and the route emits one, but the OpenAPI response and x-normative-schema both named the bare patternConsent, which the envelope does not validate against. Purely additive: no existing def, enum, required field, or $id changed.

amendments.change: Reconciled unimplemented M7 spec artifacts: optional provenance on ontology releases; optional evaluation report hashes; optional source-fragment edition/location/exclusions; reservationReason and related common defs; admin metadata/inventory/ontology-release documents; erasure-replay event with signing-key identity and a required ontology version for recall tombstones; OpenAPI paths for recall, reconcile, artifact inventory, artifact decrypt, and admin ontology release; policy-only fixture for verdict pass with unevaluated_fixture_count !== 0.
amendments.reason: docs/reviews/2026-08-16-m7-unimplemented-spec-artifacts.md required these additive documents before slices A–D implement the wrong artifact. Purely additive: no existing $id, required field, or enum member changed. purpose_class continues to be the shipped four-value list, now referenced from common.schema.json#/$defs/purposeClass.

amendments.change: Added correction_document to common.schema.json#/$defs/artifactClass for the closed writer correction path.
amendments.reason: M7 design section 13.5 requires deterministic and semantic rejections to carry a closed correction document into another writer attempt. Additive only: schema_version, $id values, required fields, and every existing enum member remain unchanged.

amendments.change: Documented PatternConsent and PatternGenerationRequest.consent_policy_version in contracts/m7/openapi/openapi.yaml: `provider` is the processor of record, the generation service is named separately in reader-facing copy, and the consent policy is versioned independently of schema_version so a grant stored under a superseded version is not an active grant.
amendments.reason: The Pattern generation path moved to the Codex runner, and consent policy 1.1.0 replaces copy that promised provider-side storage off, thirty-day retention, and training disabled by the reader's grant. Description-only and purely additive: no $id, schema_version, required field, enum member, or fixture byte changed.
